messages:
anya_devops: infra alert - ap-southeast control-plane flapping, several GPU nodes showing PROBE_RESET and high tcp_retransmits :rotating_light:
infra-bot: [ALERT] region=ap-southeast severity=critical nodes_affected=3 conn_resets=12m_rate=28%
mike_infra: seeing same in logs, kube-proxy reporting conntrack entries spike, pods reporting ECONNRESET on long-lived streams
sophie_sre: are we seeing client-side timeouts or server resets? p95 latency steady, but connection churn is killing throughput
raj_platform: this smells like a short-lived network partition at the region edge. propose a staged GSLB ramp to move traffic off ap-southeast to eu-west and na-west while preserving affinity for ongoing sessions
chris_oncall: agree staged. suggestion: start with eu-west 20%, na-west 20%, ap-southeast 60% -> ramp to eu-west 40% / na-west 40% / ap-southeast 20% over 10 minutes. set ttl 15s and allow tcp-drain timeout 30s
mike_infra: prepping autoscaler bump for eu-west and na-west GPU pools + prewarmed prefix caches. also enabling connection-proxy mode on proxy pool to reduce handshake overhead
emma_prod: cost note - na-west burst instances are ~1.4x token-cost compared to ap-southeast. approve temporary shift for availability, but please track spend delta and alert at +15%
raj_platform: I'll push a policy that does gradual weight change with ramp window. command I will run (dry-run):
```bash
# dry-run
gslbctl plan --region ap-southeast=0.6 --region eu-west=0.2 --region na-west=0.2 --ramp 10m --ttl 15
# apply
gslbctl apply --change "apac-partition-mitigation" --region ap-southeast=0.2 --region eu-west=0.4 --region na-west=0.4 --ramp 10m --ttl 15
```
chris_oncall: set failover rule: if ap-southeast health < 65% for 3 consecutive probes, escalate to emergency mode: divert 80% to na-west, 20% to eu-west. also enabling sticky cookie fallback for in-flight sessions
mike_infra: completed warmup: kvcache preheat on eu-west and na-west, autoscaler max_replicas bumped +30% eu-west / +25% na-west, logs look clean pre-change
raj_platform: running dry-run now, no errors
gslb-bot: [PLAN] change_id=chg-20260320-02 status=dry-run_ok regions_preview={ap-southeast:0.6, eu-west:0.2, na-west:0.2} ramp=10m ttl=15s
chris_oncall: executing apply in T-1m, will monitor conn resets and p99 tail latency closely. rollback if p99 > 1200ms or error_rate > 1%
infra-bot: [ACTION] change_id=chg-20260320-02 initiated by raj_platform
mike_infra: telemetry: within 4m connections to ap-southeast down 35%, eu-west/na-west load increasing as expected. conn_reset rate on ap-southeast trending down, but na-west shows small p95 spike (+80ms) while caches warm
sophie_sre: good. keep an eye on long lived streams. if any app reports resumed 5xx we might need to enable byte-stream fallback to avoid state loss
emma_prod: running a quick smoke eval against eu-west and na-west. early checks: model latency and outputs comparable, no semantic drift detected
chris_oncall: automation hit threshold: ap-southeast health dropped to 58% -> emergency rule kicked, diverting additional traffic to na-west (now na-west 55%, eu-west 35%, ap-southeast 10%)
raj_platform: logged the change_id and automated action. scheduling a post-incident runbook entry; suspected root cause: edge router firmware bug combined with maintenance window routing table update
mike_infra: monitoring cost alert - short token-cost increase to na-west ~12% since shift started. within acceptable band (per emma), keeping shift for now
sophie_sre: p99 latency on na-west stabilized after caches filled, p99=560ms now, error_rate steady at 0.2%
chris_oncall: locking change to manual revert. we'll keep this traffic split until edge router patch and a canary maintenance window confirmed
anya_devops: filing incident INC-20260320-09 and assigning to eng-infra / network team for root cause and follow-up. notes: applied gslb ramp, autoscaler bump, kvcache preheat, emergency failover triggered
infra-bot: [INCIDENT] INC-20260320-09 created by anya_devops severity=high owner=eng-infra
emma_prod: planning a controlled revert once network team patches and we run a 30m canary. please add cost delta and performance checkpoints to the revert checklist
chris_oncall: acknowledged. locking the thread for operational updates only. thanks team :thumbsup:
